## How work is done

- Free demo first: clients see a homepage or main-screen demo before paying.
- Milestone payments tied to visible progress.
- The client owns the domain, hosting, ad accounts, data and source code.
- No fake ranking, lead or “cite me in ChatGPT” guarantees.

## Locations served

India, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. Meetings run over WhatsApp, calls and video.
